description.value:
Your exocortex manages a network of mines. You can deploy these mines with the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Deploy Mine] action and activate them with the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Detonate Mine] action or reaction. Your mines are shielded and can't detonate without your activation command. The DC to Disable your mines is your class DC. You can collect all deployed and undetonated mines as a single action, storing them alongside your other prepared mines in your custom rig.

During your daily preparations, you can create a number of mines equal to 4 + your Intelligence modifier, which is also the maximum number of mines you can carry. This number increases by two at 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter. If you're below this limit, you can craft new mines using your custom rig. For every 10 minutes you spend in exploration mode, you create two mines; this doesn't prevent you from participating in other exploration activities. You can store all your mines in your custom rig without increasing its Bulk.

Though your mines are physical objects, they're destroyed if not used by the next time you make your daily preparations. They can't be duplicated or preserved in any way.

You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Modify] one of your deployed mines at a range of 60 feet as if it were a grenade. Additionally, you gain the following new mods.

  • Smart Mine (mine exocortex): You program your mines with rudimentary virtual intelligence, allowing them to recognize your allies. Select one target within 60 feet. That target is excluded from the area of all mines you detonate. At 5th level, you can select up to three targets, and at 10th level, you can select up to six targets.

  • Targeting Mine (mine exocortex): Your mines' proximity sensors calculate precise explosions. Increase the mine's damage by an amount equal to your Intelligence modifier.
